frame_rate.description: A frame rate as an exact fraction: num / den frames per second (24000/1001, 25/1...). One frame lasts 254016000000 * den / num ticks.

description: The evaluated values of the expression-driven properties of one composition whose values are not numbers (text, paths...), sampled like the numeric ones in the composition's `core.expr.baked` node. Derived (`measured`): the manifest lists the files it was computed from.

frame_step.description: Composition frames between consecutive samples. At least 1.

samples.description: Samples per property. Sample i is the value at the start tick of composition frame first_frame + i * frame_step.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema. Always 1 in profile motion-comp/1; a reader refuses the node (node scope) when it is anything else.

tracks.description: One entry per property, in ascending (layer, uid).

items.description: The samples of one expression-driven property whose value is not a list of numbers.

kind.description: The kind of the property's value (`Text`, `Path`, `Str`, `Gradient`, `Layer`).

layer.description: Id of the layer the property belongs to.

runs.description: The samples in order, run-length encoded: the runs' `frames` add up to the node's `samples`.

items.description: A run of consecutive samples with one value.

frames.description: How many consecutive samples have this value. At least 1.

value.description: The value, as a property value `{t, v}` (schema `core.motion.layer`, definition `value`).

title: core.expr.baked-values
